equity.level_reason: Coverage is reported by rurality and county SVI tertile, and urban vs rural is described as substantially higher, but values are only set side by side with no computed difference or ratio and no disparity framing, so level 2.

level_alternative.reason: Rurality and SVI are area-level stratifiers in a facility-level analysis; one could read them as descriptors with little interpretation.

equity.equity_measurement: Rurality and SVI are county-level attributes of facilities (aggregate facility data); SVI in tertiles; no person-level race, ethnicity or age available.

notes: Coverage is reported separately within each facility type; comparisons across staff type, region, urbanicity and SVI within facility type were read as two-way cross-tabs (comparison), not stratified/adjusted. Exclusion of facilities with <5 HCP and removal of contraindications from the COVID-19 denominator are design rules. State-level results are in the figure and a supplementary table.
view_issues: 'Substantially higher' is used for differences although the article states no statistical comparisons were conducted and reports no CIs or p-values; read as colloquial, not a test.
